summary: OpenRouter lists the stealth model Ox Alpha (stealth/ox-alpha) at $0 per million input and output tokens during the anonymous-provider preview. The official model page confirms the zero price in its FAQ. Press coverage reports the free preview lasts about a week from the August 20 release; OpenRouter states prompts and completions are retained by the provider and not used for training.
claim_steps: Sign in or create an account at openrouter.ai.
Create an API key at openrouter.ai/settings/keys.
Call the model with slug stealth/ox-alpha via the OpenAI-compatible API at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 (or use it in any OpenRouter-supported app).
